command:
from pathlib import Path
import sys,os,json,time
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest
copy=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(copy/'04_dashboard'));os.environ['PATH']=''
import saved_results
assert saved_results.head() is None
start=time.perf_counter();app=AppTest.from_file(str(copy/'04_dashboard/app.py'),default_timeout=180).run()
assert not app.exception and not app.error,([e.message for e in app.exception],[e.value for e in app.error])
assert len(app.tabs)==9 and all(len(t.dataframe)+len(t.markdown)>0 for t in app.tabs)
assert 'Reading files from disk (no git checkout): values are not verified against a commit.' in [w.value for w in app.warning]
r={'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'head':None,'tabs':[t.label for t in app.tabs],'exceptions':[],'metrics':{m.label:m.value for m in app.metric},'warning':[w.value for w in app.warning]}
assert r['metrics']['B3r official 100k geomean']=='0.4247 s'
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(r))
